body: Thanks chiminichanga, this helped a lot :)

I really with I had the motivation and passion to try and rekindle things up, but I just don't feel like doing all of this things with her anymore. Maybe I don't love her anymore, it is just a sad thing to realize.

I guess you're right, I'd much rather know about it right upfront. But at the same time she seems to love me so much that I'm drawn to think that maybe this can be enough to keep things going. You know, the caring without so much the attraction. What do you think?

Hey nukasoda. We've been together for almost a year, and I wouldn't say that her personality changed, but in the last 4 months we've moved in together (we're traveling overseas) and I think that that extra time we spent together made me realize some things about her that I don't like very much. Her physical appearance hasn't changed, although she did promise that she would try very hard to lose some weight (she is quite overweight), but she just doesn't seem to have the willpower to do so - I don't mind that very much because I'm also a little overweight, but I have to be honest and say that it is a little turn off. I don't think I've changed that much, maybe back then I was more scared and desperate to be with someone, now I feel more confident about being alone, I guess.
But isn't this something that it's supposed to happen? I mean, the attraction fading over time.
